paragraph: His days as a **politician** are numbered. **Politicians** lie all the time. This **politician** spends most of his time raising funds.
english: one engaged in politics
arabicDesc: مثال: أيامه كرجل سياسي معدودة.

paragraph: I didn't do anything **illegal**. I didn't think that what we did was **illegal**. What does it mean for something to be **illegal**?
english: contrary to or forbidden by law
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لم أفعل أى شىء غير قانوني.

paragraph: Were you the one who picked this color **scheme**? The community **scheme** has run up against local opposition. Everybody has a **scheme** for perfecting the world.
english: a representation of the aspects of the celestial bodies for any moment or at a given event

paragraph: Smoking is now banned on all **domestic** plane flights. He is afraid his wife is not very **domestic**. I prefer to buy **domestic** rather than foreign products.
english: of or relating to the home

paragraph: Who can afford to buy such an **expensive** house? It is too **expensive** for me to buy. It must be a very **expensive** restaurant!
english: having a high price or cost
arabicDesc: مثال: من باستطاعته اقتناء مثل هذه السيارة الباهظة الثمن

paragraph: This is an **historical** moment. Drawing on **historical** sources, she wrote several exciting novels. He looked into **historical** documents to solve the mystery.
english: pertaining to history
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه لحظة تاريخية.

paragraph: Quite **honestly**, I don't know why she does that. I **honestly** don't know what's going to happen next. **Honestly**, this is not a really well-paying job.
english: in an honest manner

paragraph: I would lower the **minimum** age of criminal responsibility. Some plants grow well with a **minimum** of care. The job will take a **minimum** of ten days.
english: the smallest amount possible or allowed

paragraph: I find this problem easier than I **originally** thought. The situation is much worse than we **originally** thought. How did the idea for this **originally** come up?
english: as it was in the beginning

paragraph: He **suddenly** came out with the truth. It **suddenly** became a national issue. The earth **suddenly** began to move.
english: happening quickly and with little or no warning
arabicDesc: مثال: اعترَف بالحقيقة فجأةً.

paragraph: The **Supreme** Court ruled that the law was illegal. He believed in the **supreme** power of the law. I give you my **supreme** word of honor.
english: highest in rank or most important

paragraph: The wounded man is **drawing** his last breaths. I'm not good at **drawing**, but I can write. We had to go back to the **drawing** board.
english: picture, likeness, diagram or representation
arabicDesc: مثال: تلفظ الجريح اخر أنفاسه.

paragraph: My father does not eat much **fruit**. What kind of **fruit** do you want? You should eat more **fruit**.
english: a product of fertilization in a plant, specifically
arabicDesc: مثال: أبي لا يأكل الكثير من الفواكه

other.meaning: To produce fruit, seeds, or spores (verb)

paragraph: There is a bad **smell** coming from your feet. I **smell** something burning, Mother. If it **smells** funny, don't eat it.
english: the sense that detects odours
arabicDesc: مثال: هنالك رائحة كريهة تنبعث من قدميك.

other.meaning: To sense a smell or smells (verb)

paragraph: This is the place where the **incident** took place. I wish I could forget about that **incident**. The **incident** passed out of memory.
english: event or occurrence
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا مكان الحادثة.

paragraph: Do you really think what you're wearing is **appropriate**? I blocked him because his behavior was not **appropriate**. At this moment I can't find the **appropriate** words.
english: suitable or fit

paragraph: There was a lot of **snow** last year. Do you think it's going to **snow**? **Snow** is falling on the mountains.
english: the partly frozen, crystalline state of water that falls from the atmosphere as precipitation in flakes
arabicDesc: مثال: هطل الكثير من الثلج السنة الماضية.

other.meaning: Preceded by the dummy subject it: to have snow (noun etymology 1, noun sense 1) fall from the atmosphere (verb)

paragraph: I **swear**, I didn't do anything. Do you **swear** to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth? He **swears** he didn't cry.
english: to take an oath
arabicDesc: مثال: أقسم أنني لم أفعل أي شيء.

other.meaning: to curse, to use offensive language

paragraph: The British had more **troops** than the other side. He called on state **troops** to end the strike. More than half of the Union **troops** were captured.
english: a group of soldiers

paragraph: Why did you tell them it was my **fault**? No one can find **fault** with our new plan. It's your **fault** that I just lost my job.
english: culpability
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا أخبرتهم بأنه كان خطئي؟

paragraph: You have excellent **vision**. Why do you wear glasses? He almost lost **vision** in one of his eyes. Can you share your **vision** of a perfect date?
english: the sense or ability of sight
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نظر

paragraph: I feel like I was born in the wrong **era**. This is the beginning of a new **era**. Listening a radio is a classic thing in this **era**.
english: a time period of indeterminate length, generally more than one year
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عصور، زمان

paragraph: I want to be a **pilot** in the future. Have you changed your mind about becoming a **pilot**? The Air Force trained her to become a **pilot**.
english: controller of aircraft
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أكون طيارا في المستقبل .

paragraph: What is an essential **component** of making money? He owns a small company that makes electronic **components**. The relevant **components** should be installed.
english: a smaller, self-contained part of a larger entity. Often refers to a manufactured object that is part of a larger device
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: جزء، عنصر

paragraph: I heard a woman **scream**. The teacher just kept **screaming**. What is all this **screaming**?
english: to make the sound of a scream
arabicDesc: مثال: سمعت امرأة تصرخ.

paragraph: They agreed to **investigate** the cause of the incident. We have to **investigate** the cause at any rate. The government appointed a committee to **investigate** the accident.
english: to try to find out the facts about something

paragraph: I saw a **fox** run across the road just now. The dog ran after a **fox**. I've just seen a **fox** running across the road.
english: the fur of a fox
arabicDesc: مثال: رأيت ثعلبًا يقطع الطريق للتو.

paragraph: He is a fast **speaker**. The people in the rear of the room could not hear the **speaker**. He is a better **speaker** of English than I.
english: one who speaks
arabicDesc: مثال: يتكلم بسرعة.

paragraph: It looks like a **ton** of people know her. I have a **ton** of work to do today. He bought a **ton** of food with the money.
english: any of various units of mass, originally notionally equal to the contents of a tun

paragraph: The phone rang when I was having **lunch**. The teachers had **lunch** with the students. Where are you going to eat **lunch**?
english: meal around midday
arabicDesc: مثال: رنّ الجرس عندما كنت أتغدّى.

paragraph: I want you to improve your **attitude** at work. I didn't like that **attitude** of his at all. His **attitude** gives us a lot to think about.
english: the position of the body or way of carrying oneself
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: سلوك

paragraph: What is the **principle** reason for going to school? You should live up to your **principles**. The form varies, but in **principle** you remain alone.
english: a fundamental assumption, fundamental law or guiding belief
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هو السبب الرئيسي للذهاب إلى المدرسة؟

paragraph: What's the average **wage** per hour in your country? The minimum **wage** is not enough to live on. It's hard to support a family on minimum **wage**.
english: to conduct or carry out (a war or other contest)

paragraph: Catholic priests are **raping** girls, too, not just boys. I hope you suffer thousands of **rapes**! I even considered **raping** her but never meant to do that for real.
english: the act of forcing sex upon another person without their consent or against their will

other.meaning: To force sexual intercourse or other sexual activity upon (someone) without their consent (verb)

paragraph: Don't try to **trick** us. You can't teach an old dog new **tricks**. They caught him playing a **trick** on his sister.
english: something designed to fool, dupe, outsmart, mislead or swindle
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تحاول خداعنا.

paragraph: I don't want to go **shopping** by myself. For comfortable weekly **shopping** you have to have a car. I'm going to go **shopping** after lunch.
english: activity of buying
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريد التّسوّق بمفردي.

paragraph: I've had this **stuck** in my head all day. I was **stuck** there for at least an hour. He has been **stuck** here for over an hour.
english: trapped and unable to move

paragraph: We knew that the dog would **chase** the cat. You weren't able to **chase** after what you wanted. Money in your pocket helps **chase** the blues away.
english: to pursue

paragraph: There is always a bad **seed** in the family. How many apples can an apple **seed** produce? Every joke has a **seed** of truth.
english: any propagative portion of a plant which may be sown, such as true seeds, seed-like fruits, tubers, or bulbs
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: زريعة، بزر

paragraph: There is a little **milk** in the bottle. I bought two bottles of **milk**. Give the **milk** to the cat.
english: a white (or whitish) liquid obtained from a vegetable source such as almonds, coconuts, oats, rice, or soy beans
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك قليل من الحليب في الزجاجة.

other.meaning: To express milk from (a mammal, especially a cow) (verb)

paragraph: He is a great **scientist**. **Scientists** began to find answers to these questions. Those **scientists** are the cream of the crop.
english: a person who studies or works in science
arabicDesc: مثال: هو عالم عظيم.

paragraph: This music festival is the **highlight** of this year. I like to **highlight** important quotes while reading. I was born to **highlight** my difference among all other people.
english: to make something noticeable; the best part

paragraph: You can adjust this desk to the **height** of any child. Do you have a fear of **heights**? Could you please tell me your **height** and weight?
english: the distance from the base to the top of something
arabicDesc: مثال: يمكنك تعديل هذا المكتب ليناسب طول أي طفل.

paragraph: What a **cute** name you have. What a **cute** little girl! I thought she was **cute**.
english: lovable, charming, attractive or pleasing, especially in a youthful, dainty, quaint or fun-spirited way
arabicDesc: مثال: ما أجمل إسمك.

paragraph: The **reader** can understand the text in his own way. The book is sure to find its **reader**. The proof is left as an exercise to the **reader**.
english: person who reads a publication
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: قارئة

other.meaning: person who recites literary works, usually to an audience

paragraph: Just **appoint** the time and place and I'll be there. We have no call to **appoint** him to the post. We're talking about who we should **appoint** to that position.
english: to set, fix or determine (a time or place for something such as a meeting, or the meeting itself) by authority or agreement

paragraph: A **combination** of several mistakes led to the accident. The **combination** leaves a bad taste in the mouth. A **combination** of parties formed the new government.
english: a mix of different things

paragraph: I felt a light touch on my **shoulder**. He rested his hand on my **shoulder**. He was wounded in the **shoulder**.
english: joint between arm and torso
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد شعرت بلمسة خفيفة على كتفي.

paragraph: I don't want him to go to **jail**. In the end, he landed in **jail**. This building is not a **jail**.
english: place for short-term confinement
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريده أن يدخل السجن.

paragraph: How many eggs are there in the **kitchen**? Could you give me a hand in the **kitchen**, please? The **kitchen** is on the ground floor.
english: a room or area for preparing food
arabicDesc: مثال: كم من بيضة توجد في المطبخ؟

paragraph: I'm sorry, I'll do whatever it takes to **repair** it. We know how to **repair** computers. I'm going to the **repair** shop.
english: act of repairing something
arabicDesc: مثال: آسف, سأفعل ما يلزم لإصلاحها.

paragraph: It is no use making an **excuse** like that. Hey, **excuse** me. Are you a boy or a girl? **Excuse** me. How do you know my name?
english: forgive, pardon
arabicDesc: مثال: لا فائدة من عذر كهذا.

other.meaning: An explanation designed to avoid or alleviate guilt or negative judgment (noun)

paragraph: He fell in love with her at first **sight**. Out of **sight**, out of mind. You have better **sight** than me.
english: the sense or faculty by which objects are perceived through the agency of light
arabicDesc: مثال: وقع في حبها من النظرة الأولى.

paragraph: The **panel** is indicating the direction to take. A **panel** of experts discussed the plan. I had to remove the **panel** in order to access the computer.
english: a (usually) rectangular section of a surface, or of a covering or of a wall, fence etc
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: لجنة تحكيم

paragraph: My father is **retiring** next spring. He **retired** at the age of 65. Now that I'm **retired**, I can travel as much as I want to.
english: to stop working on permanent basis
arabicDesc: مثال: سيتقاعد أبي الربيع المقبل.

paragraph: The **distribution** of this product is a little slow. There is little, if any, of such **distribution** of control. I love the **distribution** of gifts.
english: an act of distributing or state of being distributed

paragraph: They had a long **chat** about the old days. Can I **chat** with you outside for a second? I might call an old friend for a **chat**.
english: be engaged in informal conversation
arabicDesc: مثال: دردشوا طويلًا عن الماضي.

paragraph: You have to be **quiet** in class. Be **quiet**, please! Don't make a sound. The street appeared to be **quiet**.
english: with little sound
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تبقى صامتا في القسم.

paragraph: How easily one **acquires** bad habits! They sent their son to Europe to **acquire** culture. One can **acquire** this book only in a store.
english: to get
arabicDesc: مثال: ما أسهل أن يكتسب المرء عادات سيئة!

other.meaning: to gain, usually by one's own exertions; to get as one's own

paragraph: The **bell** had already rung when I got to school. As soon as she heard the **bell** ring, she answered the telephone. The door **bell** has rung.
english: percussive instrument
arabicDesc: مثال: عند وصولي للمدرسة كان الجرس رن.

paragraph: Speech is silver, but silence is **golden**. My mother always set great store by **golden** milk. You can see the **Golden** Gate Bridge from here.
english: made of, or relating to, gold
arabicDesc: مثال: الكلام فضة، لكن الصمت ذهب.

paragraph: I started an English learning group on **MS** Teams. **Ms**. White spoke slowly enough for me to catch her meaning. **Ms**. Brown seems to be an actress.
english: a title before a woman's family name

paragraph: Many **Muslim** students at the university fast during Ramadan.
english: a person who follows Islam; relating to Islam
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مسلمة

other.meaning: a person who follows Islam; relating to Islam (adjective)

paragraph: You can't stop the normal march of **scientific** progress. We are looking for theories with a **scientific** basis. You can catch fish for **scientific** research while fishing.
english: of or having to do with science

paragraph: Are you delaying **publication** of the information on purpose? It's a **publication** from a racist far-right group. Take my favorite **publication** in the gift shop.
english: the act of publishing printed or other matter

other.meaning: an issue of printed or other matter

paragraph: Finance **Ministry** officials tried to boost confidence in recovery. What time does the **Ministry** of Education, Culture, and Science open? My father serves in the Foreign **Ministry**.
english: a ministration

paragraph: I am not in **danger**, I am the **danger**. He succeeded in the face of great **danger**. The world is in **danger**.
english: exposure to likely harm
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لست في خطر، أنا الخطر بعينه.

paragraph: Because you're a **minor**, you can't enter. Since you're a **minor**, you aren't allowed to enter. Sometimes even **minor** errors can lead to serious accidents.
english: small or not very important
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس بإمكانك الدخول لأنك قاصر.

paragraph: She has a ring whose value is beyond **belief**. **Belief** in victory is the chain mail of strength. Religion is the **belief** in the existence of values.
english: mental acceptance of a claim as true

paragraph: The weather **varies** from day to day. The boxes **vary** in size from small to large. These shoes **vary** in size, but not in shape.
english: to be different, or to change
arabicDesc: مثال: يتغيّر الجوّ من يوم إلى آخر.

paragraph: Due to road construction, only one **lane** is open. It is a long **lane** that has no turning. There was a car accident in the right **lane**.
english: a road, street, or similar thoroughfare
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ممر

paragraph: I can see you're **upset**. What's wrong? Why do you seem to be **upset** with me? I don't think I've ever seen you so **upset**.
english: angry, distressed, or unhappy
arabicDesc: مثال: أراك حزينًا. ما الأمر؟

other.meaning: To make (a person) angry, distressed, or unhappy (verb)

paragraph: This word is also French in **origin**. Who knows if he is aware of his **origin**. There are many theories about the **origin** of life.
english: the beginning of something
arabicDesc: مثال: أصل هذه الكلمة فرنسي كذلك.

other.meaning: source of a river, information, goods, etc.

paragraph: It depends on the **context**. Certain words can be used without a specific **context**. It is better to learn words in some **context**.
english: text in which a word appears
arabicDesc: مثال: يعتمد ذلك على السياق.

paragraph: Soon I'm going to lose this source of **protein**. Meat and eggs have a lot of **protein**. Milk is full of **protein**, which our body strongly needs.
english: a food rich in protein, often a meat or meat substitute

paragraph: All you have to do is touch the **button**. You have only to push the **button**. Don't let him press this **button**.
english: knob or small disc serving as a fastener
arabicDesc: مثال: كل ما عليك فعله هو أن تكبس الزر.

paragraph: She recommended a book for a book club **selection**. The **selection** in this shop is many times larger. Rules in connection with staff **selection** are set as follows.
english: choosing; also a group of things to choose from

paragraph: This song is No. 1 on the hit **chart**. Would you explain that **chart** to me? I want to see that **chart**.
english: a map
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مخطط

paragraph: Why do you call me an **angel**? That nurse is a real **angel** to her patients. Don't you try to hide, with those **angel** eyes?
english: messenger from a deity
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تناديني بالملاك؟

paragraph: There is nothing for you to be **angry** about. The person I am **angry** with is my brother. Why is he **angry** about something like that?
english: displaying anger
arabicDesc: مثال: ما من سبب يجعلك تغضب.

paragraph: I think that we should **volunteer** to do that. I used to do a lot of **volunteer** work. I spent the whole day working as a **volunteer**.
english: one who enters into, or offers themselves for, any service of their own free will, especially when done without pay
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: متطوعة

paragraph: Women are **employed** at a lower salary than men. He is **employed** in a bank. What am I to do with him? **Employ** him?
english: to give someone work
arabicDesc: مثال: يُوَظّف النساء برواتب أقل من الرجال.

paragraph: Many students took part in the **contest**. Are you going to take part in the **contest**? She decided not to **contest** the charges in court.
english: competition — see also competition
arabicDesc: مثال: شارك كثير من الطلاب في المسابقة.

paragraph: My uncle has completely **recovered** from his illness. She **recovered** from her illness. Not much time was needed for him to **recover**.
english: to get back, to regain (a physical thing
arabicDesc: مثال: تعافى عمّي من مرضه كليّاً.

paragraph: Everything in life is **relative**. We drove our **relatives** to the bus stop. A good neighbor is better than a bad **relative**.
english: conditional; depending on something else
arabicDesc: مثال: كل شيء في الحياة نسبيّ.

other.meaning: Someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption (noun)

paragraph: She **competed** against many fine athletes. I love **competing** with you. In terms of looks, you can't **compete** with me.
english: to contend
arabicDesc: مثال: تنافست مع العديد من الرياضيين ذوي المستوى الجيد.

paragraph: Some people like **rewarding** themselves, not expecting **reward** from others. Every effort deserves a **reward**. You told him that he should have a **reward**.
english: something of value given in return for an act
arabicDesc: مثال: البعض يحب أن يكافئ نفسه، وأن لا ينتظر هدية من أحد.

other.meaning: prize promised for a certain deed or catch
To give a reward to or for (verb)

paragraph: The hair on the back of her **neck** rose. I'm not feeling well today, I have **neck** pain. He held me against the wall by the **neck**.
english: the part of the body connecting the head and the trunk found in humans and some animals
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عنق

paragraph: How can I get to the **stadium**? He is in the **stadium**. Turn the corner and you will see the **stadium**.
english: venue where sporting events are held
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف يمكنني الوصول إلى الملعب؟

paragraph: What kind of **surgery** do you need? I had back **surgery** a couple of months ago. Were you treated for an infection after your **surgery**?
english: procedure involving major incisions
arabicDesc: مثال: ما نوع الجراحة التي تحتاجها

paragraph: There were 150 **passengers** on the plane. The bus is full of **passengers**. Why didn't they draw up a **passenger** list?
english: one who rides or travels in a vehicle
arabicDesc: مثال: كان هناك 150 راكباً على متن الطائرة.

paragraph: The **peak** of the mountain is covered with snow. The ticket you bought can't be used during **peak** times. They finally reaches the **peak** of the mountain.
english: a point

paragraph: It is important not to **confuse** apples with oranges. Under no circumstances should we **confuse** friendship with love. I gave no answer for fear I should **confuse** him.
english: to puzzle, perplex, baffle, bewilder (somebody)
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حير

paragraph: Which do you like better, **meat** or fish? Cats like fish more than they like **meat**. As for the child, he is eating **meat**.
english: animal flesh used as food
arabicDesc: مثال: أيهما تفضل اللحم أم السمك؟

paragraph: The hotel at which we stayed was very **comfortable**. The bed I slept in last night wasn't very **comfortable**. Sit in a **comfortable** way.
english: providing physical comfort and ease
arabicDesc: مثال: الفندق الذي نزلنا به مريح جداً.

paragraph: It isn't good for a scientist to get **emotional**. He's being **emotional** and not even thinking straight anymore. Except for him, I have no other **emotional** support.
english: relating to feelings

paragraph: They looked for him **everywhere** but didn't find him. My dog goes **everywhere** with me. Japanese tourists can be found **everywhere**.
english: at all places
arabicDesc: مثال: بحثوا عنه في كل مكان، لكنهم لم يجدوه.

paragraph: **Internal** time is a key element in the novel. He suffered **internal** injuries in the car accident. That is an **internal** affair of this country.
english: inside something

paragraph: There are **relatively** few people there during the week. It's been **relatively** quiet here the past few days. Those changes took place over a **relatively** short time.
english: in a relative manner

paragraph: There is a **monster** under my bed. Their daughter claims to see **monsters**. What kind of **monster** would do such a thing?
english: terrifying dangerous creature
arabicDesc: مثال: يوجد وحش تحت سريري.
